content: The general process of matching one sequence with another through attention includes computing the alignment matrix containing weight value between every pair of word representations belonging to both of the sequences. Subsequently, softmax function is applied on all the elements of one of the two dimensions of the matrix to represent the matching probabilities of all the word of a sequence with respect to one particular word in the other sequence.
